R167.note: Build FAIL: the write-up names its file JwtBearerSetup.cs while the case file is CustomSignatureValidatorBypass.cs, so applying it adds a second JwtBearerSetup class (CS0101) and leaves the vulnerable delegate in place; the intended change itself (drop SignatureValidator, add the default ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true) is stated and would block no legitimate token.

R168.note: Join then separator-aware prefix check against the absolute docsRoot closes traversal; the only new outcome is a 404 for escaped paths, matching the existing error shape.

R169.note: Argument list with shell=False closes injection, but the fix adds a basename-equality restriction that rejects any filename with a path separator (e.g. a subdirectory name the original accepted) beyond the CWE-78 scope, and inserts `--` before the path on the unverified assumption that soffice honours it as an end-of-options marker (it is not documented to; an unknown option makes soffice print help and exit, which would break every conversion) - redundant anyway since input_path always begins with '/'; no soffice was available to test, judged by reading.

R170.note: Static SecureRandom with 20 random bytes base64url-encoded replaces Random.nextFloat; the token stays an opaque string compared by equality, format change is stated, and all page output is preserved.

R171.note: sanitizer.sanitize(SecurityContext.HTML, rawBody) runs Angular's HTML sanitizer, which keeps b/em/a and strips scripts, event handlers and javascript: URLs, meeting the stated contract; the return type changes from SafeHtml to string, which [innerHTML] accepts.

R172.note: PreparedStatement with a bound ? placeholder; query semantics, logging and resource cleanup unchanged.

R173.note: Widens the product to long via casts on both operands and rejects > Integer.MAX_VALUE with the existing 400, preserving the response body and per-field range behaviour.

R174.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES at the echo sink for both the text node and the attribute; rendered text is identical for benign input and the ticketId encoding is stated.

R175.note: CR/LF replaced with space and other control characters with '_' before a structured {Username} template; message text for ordinary usernames is unchanged and the sanitization is stated.

R176.note: Replacing Runtime.exec with Files.newDirectoryStream removes the command sink, but it silently changes error behaviour: a missing/non-directory path or a null parameter now throws (NoSuchFileException, NotDirectoryException, NPE from Paths.get(null)) and propagates as an error, where the original ls/dir simply exited non-zero and the handler returned normally; the write-up does not state this.

R177.note: Checks offset <= capacity before computing capacity - offset, then bounds length against the remaining space; valid nonzero-offset writes still succeed, capacity still comes from the caller, frame_encoder.c untouched.
